'''Mistress Carin''' is a servant in the [[Tarasin Palace]]. She is dark, grim-faced and in her middle years. She wears a [[marriage knife]].

==Activities==
When [[Mat]] wants to see [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]], Carin takes Mat from [[Jen]] to [[Matilde]], who are two other servants in the Tarasin Palace.
